Hi Elena — quick technical notes to accompany the artifacts: 

1) RTO/RPO testing: our last warmstart exercise was executed 2027-07-03 01:15:00 UTC. Measured cold-path recovery (full service rebuild) was ~13m20s (RTO), and KV priming to reach steady-state 95th percentile latency was ~6m40s (RPO-equivalent for operational readiness). These figures are in the attached manifest.

2) KV cache snapshots: the tarball contains a set of compressed snapshots captured from the inference nodes prior to the warmstart (timestamps included in file headers). TTLs: 24h for model KV segments, 6h for session-level caches (documented in manifest). Cache priming steps are: a) restore snapshot to node-local storage, b) load model weights and KV into memory, c) replay a small prompt set to warm hot paths. We've included an excerpt of the exact replay script and a trimmed execution log (warmstart-exec-log-20270703.txt).

3) Dependency map: a single-page diagram (included in rpo-rto-manifest_v1.pdf) lists required services: config-store, metadata DB (replica), object storage, auth service for key access, and our KV store. For the live witness we'll run through the dependency checklist.

Operational notes: during the warmstart we do not require access to customer data; test prompts are synthetic and stored only in ephemeral logs. If you need signed attestation language, Laura — can you supply the legal-approved wording we should use?

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Director, Production Operations
Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
